title: Paid via Reseller but Account Still Suspended for Non-Payment
agent_context: Customer paid via an authorized reseller but account is suspended for non-payment. Verify reseller invoice details, open a partner billing investigation, and provide a restoration timeline or temporary access path if policy allows.

raw_content.initial_message: We paid our authorized reseller last week and we have the invoice and bank confirmation. But when my team tried to log in today, our account is suspended for non-payment. We’re rolling this out across multiple teams this week — we can’t afford downtime because of a billing mismatch between you and the reseller. What do you need from me to fix this right now?
raw_content.context: Customer payment handled via reseller/partner. Suspension likely due to settlement lag or remittance mapping gap. Policy: confirm reseller details safely; open partner billing case; coordinate mapping; offer temporary access mitigation if policy allows; set timeline + cadence.

correct_sop_steps: Offer temporary access if policy allows

sticky_notes: KEY: Operational downtime is their fear—give ownership.
HINT: Invoice ID + payment date usually enough.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Customer stabilizes when billing case is opened with checklist + timeline
